name: Gated Linear Attention (GLA) — Production-Hardened (v3).
description: Gated Linear Attention (GLA) — Production-Hardened (v3).  Multi-head linear recurrent attention with data-dependent decay gating, multiplicative SiLU output gating, denominator normalization, and pretrained weight transfer. Supports DistilBERT, RoBERTa, GPT-2, and Qwen.  Fixes in v3:   GLA3-FIX-01  Explicit shape assertion in `__init__` for num_heads, head_dim,                decay_gate, log_decay
